html:
An army captain who seized power in Burkina Faso in September 2022, at 34 the world's youngest head of state, in the second coup of that year.

He overthrew Paul-Henri Damiba, who had himself ousted the elected president in January, for failing against the jihadist insurgency. Traore expelled French troops in 2023, turned to Russia, and with Mali and Niger formed the Alliance of Sahel States, which left ECOWAS. He mobilised civilian volunteers for the war, suspended media and drafted critics. He styles himself after Thomas Sankara and has a large following online across Africa.
sum: An army captain who seized power in Burkina Faso in September 2022, at 34 the world's youngest head of state, in the second coup of that year.
